info.name: COMP3123 Assignment 2 - Employee Manager API
info.description:
Tests for the Employee Manager backend (Assignment 1 backend, updated for Assignment 2).

How to run:
1. Start the backend (default http://localhost:5001) and MongoDB.
2. Set the working directory to backend/postman so the picture files are found.
3. Run the collection in order (Collection Runner), or from a terminal:
   npx newman run COMP3123_Assignment2.postman_collection.json --working-dir .

Change the baseUrl collection variable to test another address (for example a cloud deployment).
Folder 8 deliberately triggers rate limiting; see its description before re-running.

Expired token: not part of this collection because it needs a very short token lifetime. To test it, start the backend with JWT_EXPIRES_IN=5s, log in, wait six seconds and call any employee endpoint: the API answers 401 with code TOKEN_EXPIRED.

Upload, display, replace and reject pictures. Allowed: JPEG, PNG, WebP up to 2 MB.

The file requests use relative paths (fixtures/...). In Postman, set the working directory to the backend/postman folder (Settings, General, Working directory), or run with newman --working-dir backend/postman.

item.name: 8. Rate limiting (run last)
8.1 Login with a wrong password until blocked (429)

exec: pm.test('429 Too Many Requests after ' + count + ' failed logins', () => {
pm.test('401 for failed attempt ' + count, () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
postman.setNextRequest('8.1 Login with a wrong password until blocked (429)');
pm.test('the login limiter blocked the client within 30 attempts', () => pm.expect.fail('never received 429'));

request.description: Repeats itself until the API answers 429. The default limit is 10 failed logins per 15 minutes per IP address.

item.name: 8.2 A correct login is refused while blocked (429)

exec: pm.test('429 Too Many Requests: signup is limited too', () => {
pm.test('the signup limiter blocked the client within 30 attempts', () => pm.expect.fail('never received 429'));

item.description: Deliberately triggers the limiters. Afterwards this IP address is blocked from logging in and signing up for the rest of the 15 minute window, so this folder must stay last. Restart the backend (the counters live in memory) or wait 15 minutes before running the collection again.
